title: THE BARYON-FRACTION PIN: the halo-scale depleted share (<s_b> = 0.0846 = 0.54 x f_b) vs the cosmic 0.157 -- the depletion chain (star share, gas retention, feedback, the G178 group floor), the group-cosmic two-rung bridge, the decision (pinned -> a 5-input framework, or input still), and the finally-settled input count.

V1_depletion_chain.statement: THE DEPLETION CHAIN: ASSEMBLED, ARITHMETICALLY CLOSED, PHYSICS-OPEN.  The chain s_b = f_retention x f_b with the committed links -- stars (cosmic Omega_star/Omega_b = 5.5%; group convention 0.02 = 25% of the retained 0.081), gas retention (f_gas,500 median 0.061 = 75% of the retained, 39% of the cosmic budget, R500-truncated), feedback (the measured retention mass-run +0.34 dex/dex and the group f_gas rise +0.536 vs cluster +0.235, G143 -- reionization + ejection, mechanism statement only, no committed quantitative budget), and the G178 floor (0.081 = 0.061 + 0.02, retention 0.52) -- CLOSES at f_b = <s_b>/0.54 = 0.1567 vs the datum 0.1564 (delta +0.20%), an IDENTITY on measured sides: the depletion factor 0.54 IS the measured ratio <s_b>/f_b (G187), and the ejected share (1 - retention = 0.48 group / 0.46 halo mean) is never partitioned between 'beyond R500' and 'genuinely ejected' on the committed record.  Completion status: every link is MEASURED (E11 gas -- UNVERIFIED-in-repo, gated vs G125; F&P stars; the pie's measured nods); the framework's machinery contributes zero terms; the chain's first-principles content resides in the feedback MECHANISM STATEMENT, which is standard astrophysics, quantified nowhere in-repo.

V2_derived_f_b_band.statement: THE DERIVED f_b BAND: under the SAME depletion factor 0.54, the two independent rungs give f_b(rung A, groups) = 0.081/0.54 = 0.1500 and f_b(rung B, halo mean) = 0.0846/0.54 = 0.1567 -- the TWO-RUNG CONSISTENCY BAND [0.1500, 0.1567], centre 0.1533, which brackets the Planck datum 0.1564 to 4.1% on the low edge.  WITH THE HONEST SYSTEMATICS (f_gas,500 calibration, the 0.02 star convention, the R500 truncation: retention +/- 0.07, ~13%): f_b = 0.157 +/- 0.018 = [0.139, 0.180] -- the task's 0.157 +/- 0.02 bracket, datum inside.  BUT the central value reproduces the datum ONLY because both factors of the ratio (the numerator <s_b> and the denominator 0.54 = <s_b>/f_b) carry it: the band is a CONSISTENCY BAND, not a prediction band.  The genuinely new content: two independent measurements of halo baryon content (26 E11 groups vs the Tinker-weighted pie) are mutually consistent and consistent with the cosmic datum at 4%.

V3_honest_statement.statement: HONEST -- THE BARYON FRACTION IS NOT PINNED BY THE HALO-DEPLETION CHAIN; IT REMAINS AN INPUT, NOW HALO-ANCHORED.  The chain closes arithmetically (f_b = <s_b>/0.54 = 0.1567 = the datum to +0.20%) but as a DERIVATION it is an identity on measured sides (G03C class): the depletion factor 0.54 is THE MEASURED RATIO of the halo baryon share to the cosmic share -- you must input f_b to state the chain, so recovering f_b from it proves nothing; the framework contributes zero machinery to the chain (no a0, m, Z, ladder, equilibrium or M_sat term; the feedback physics is standard astrophysics, unquantified in-repo); every link is a measured share (E11 gas, UNVERIFIED-in-repo; F&P stars; the pie's measured cluster nods).  THE INPUT COUNT, FINALLY SETTLED: six core inputs (a0, G, c, Omega_Lambda, f_b, m) = 4 measured (f_b = 0.157 among them) + 1 identity-pinned (a0) + 1 derived (m) -- the '5-input framework' is NOT earned; f_b stays in the measured column.  WHAT B09 ADDS TO S05: the halo-scale ANCHOR -- the two rungs (group floor 0.081, halo mean 0.0846) render the cosmic datum consistent at 4% (band [0.150, 0.157]) and the systematic envelope 0.157 +/- 0.02 brackets Planck -- a measured cross-check the framework can now point to, exactly as the 'depleted halo baryon share' was S05's only f_b-adjacent emission: it is a consistency statement, not a derivation, and f_b = 0.157 remains the last measured input of the cosmic frame.
V3_honest_statement.one_line: f_b = 0.157 is NOT pinned by the halo-depletion chain -- the chain's depletion factor 0.54 is itself the measured ratio of the halo baryon share to the cosmic share (G03C identity, no framework mechanism anywhere); f_b remains an input, now halo-ANCHORED at 4% (the two rungs 0.081 / 0.0846 render the datum consistent, band [0.150, 0.157]); the input count is finally settled at SIX core = 4 measured + 1 identity-pinned (a0) + 1 derived (m) -- the 5-input framework is not earned
